$comment: Shared opencode-aesthetic design tokens for the Coding Gauntlet. Every gate (1->4) consumes THIS file so the look is identical from terminal to iOS. Signature colors (background/primary/accent/secondary) are confirmed from the opencode default theme; the rest are close approximations marked APPROX and should be reconciled against the canonical opencode.json in the opencode repo during Gate 1.

font.note: opencode is a terminal-native aesthetic — monospace EVERYWHERE (UI chrome + content). Recommended ramp: a coding typeface such as Berkeley Mono / IBM Plex Mono / JetBrains Mono. Confirm opencode's exact webfont during Gate 1 and pin it here.

primary.role: warm amber — cursor, links, primary action, own messages

accent.role: purple — headings, keywords, agent name accents

syntax.$comment: Code-block highlighting — opencode renders model code output with these. APPROX, reconcile in Gate 1.
